scope: Nine observed UI translation defects only: seven PullRequests keys and two Agent reasoningLow keys. Existing data and unrelated catalog keys preserved.
sourceRead: components/pull-requests/pr-viewer-callout.tsx:64 (provider placeholder substitution and unavailable authorization state)
findings: Spanish and Italian literal provider-before-sentence substitution generated ungrammatical authorization banners.
Italian and Brazilian Portuguese open-state badge used imperative action instead of state adjective.
German split diff label meant share rather than side-by-side comparison.
Italian Luce and Portuguese Claro incorrectly described lighting in the code-worker reasoning badge; Light means reduced reasoning effort.
